gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.unknown_hint: Shrines, books and clerics would tell you more.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.turning: Turning to %1$s: %2$s of %3$s days. Your patron will mark you.

gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.rite_hi: A town cleric can ease the trials, for a price.

gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.hearthke: Every wound heals a little slower.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.anvil_fa: Tools wear a little faster; the anvil's perfect zone is narrower.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.deep_mot: Your breath runs out a little faster under water.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.green_hu: Wild beasts notice you from farther off.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.lantern_: Your blows on the dead land weaker, and the dead see you farther at night.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.crowned_: Guards halt you more often; Valor feats are worth less.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.ash_whis: Locks are tighter and pockets slower for you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.scar.truth: Those of the Truth think less of you, and your accusations carry less weight.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.anvil_f: Tools in your hands wear faster, and your smithing slips.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.deep_mo: Storms find you, lightning is drawn to you, and the water pulls you under.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.green_h: Wild beasts see you sooner and turn on you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.lantern: At night the dead see you from afar and come for you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.crowned: Guards halt and search you more, and good name comes slower.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.ash_whi: Witnesses see you from farther, and the guards hunt you longer.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.patrons.trial.truth: The Truth's townsfolk shun you, and the clerics call you out.
